Through their difficulty and unsuccessful attempt at locating the Leopard, we stopped at the side of the road to try and locate it ourselves , after about 10 minutes and about to give up, we saw a tail moving no less than 15m from us. Imagine the moment of being flabbergasted, after having a long day looking for predators no less than 1km away from us , this time the fella was right infront of our eyes, and on a day we just wanted to get back home asap. After spotting it, we saw it pounce up onto the stump of the tree and begin to climb it. Definitely a sight to remember

tingDescription: "Beautiful young, lone lioness, she seemed to be headed towards a couple of Buffalo nearby on the opposite side of a deep drainage line. She wanted to cross over but the embankment was too steep. She lay down and watched the Buffs movement from behind some shrubs for a while then got up stood "weighing up her options" and decided again that she was not able to cross unseen. She came back up and headed in the direction she came from and was looking for a better crossing. We lost sight of her in the thickets. Wonderful sighting, we were the only vehicle."
